title: KED-STAT-001: four replay run totals over a fifteen-function residual family
status_plain: The standing residual register for the statistical distributions publishes four replay totals and no per-surface figures at all. They are run totals over a fifteen-function family and must never be read as any one surface's pass rate. The register also carries a stale claim: it still lists the BETA.DIST/BETADIST integer-shape CDF repair as landed, and lane 3 removed that path after proving Excel has no such special case.
